definition: Source frame first video-PES packet submitted to TCP socket through complete JPEG/vector package acceptance at agent API. Includes transport/decode/inference/policy/evidence/handoff. Excludes camera capture/encoder and internal agent/Management work. Runtime zero-clamped age is not the primary measure.
continuous_unwrap_rule: First marker must have one prior matching transmission. Following images are ordered by camera/session/source-frame ordinal; modulo progression tracks repeats. Gaps >= half the120s loop or implausible progress invalidate alignment, rather than selecting a recent copy of a delayed old frame.

other_fullframe_events.scope: Additional full-frame JPEGs only. Crops/unparseable branch IDs excluded. Scene anchors unwrap loops; age includes candidate/temporal confirmation. Gallery sampling may be partial, so small samples do not establish an SLA.
